lines.t: [Intro - Heavy Synth Bass, Pulsing Electronic Beat, Eerie Ambient Noise]
I was keeping score in a shadowed room
Watching gold poured out into someone’s hands
While I sat desolate in my own dry lands
Forgive the silence, forgive the glass
I built between us as the hours passed
Born of water, born of crimson fire
How did I forget my own desire?
I took three steps back when you held the door
Begging for crumbs on an ocean floor
Are you listening?
Can you hear the shift?
Now I’m reaching out for the velvet seam!
Waking myself from this hollow dream!
You don’t measure love in a rusted scale
You don’t tear the cloth just to let me fail!
I drop the weights, I let go of the line—
My First Love... I claim what is mine!
[Instrumental Drop - Early Glitchy, Electronic Breakdown, Stuttering Synths] (<-- Added here!)
She pushed through the crowd with blood on her feet
Just to press her skin to the woven weave
If grace is an ocean, why did I stall?
Standing at the shore, afraid to fall
Different vessels for different tasks
One carries iron, one carries glass
The heavier crown bears the noon-day heat
So why did I envy another's seat?
Now I’m reaching out for the velvet seam!
Waking myself from this hollow dream!
You don’t measure love in a rusted scale
You don’t tear the cloth just to let me fail!
I drop the weights, I let go of the line—
My First Love... I claim what is mine!
With every thread of my mind and heart
I tear the comparison apart!
No scorching sun can burn my skin
Where the shadows leave and the light begins
Every tear I wept in the dark alone
Is washed away on the threshold stone!
[Instrumental Drop - Dark, Glitchy, Electronic Breakdown] (<-- Second one later in the song)
I’m grabbing the edge of the woven seam!
No longer living inside the dream!
Your love isn't measured, your grace isn't bought
It’s everything I ever sought!
I drop the weights, I let go of the line—
My First Love... I claim what is mine!
No more hunger... no more thirst.
The last in line becomes the first.
My First Love...
I'm stepping in.
(Outro Beat Drops to Total Silence)
